sections.heading: Our capabilities span the entire product lifecycle.
sections.text:
With AI-ready design infrastructure that scales across brands and accelerates development, we build for intelligent experiences from day one.
Product Design
User Research & Testing at Scale
Decision-first UX
End-to-End Experience Design
We combine generative research to find unmet needs with evaluative testing where AI analyzes sessions to reveal friction patterns, behavioral clusters, and opportunities quickly. We also run workshops to define vision, mission, and product direction.
Every interface is structured around the decision the user needs to make. We work backward from that decision to define what data, context, and AI support needs to be present on screen.
We map experiences across every touchpoint and channel, not just the screen: journeys, service blueprints and the moments where a product hands off to a person. AI helps us model the whole journey and spot where it breaks.
Brand Expression across Products
Design Systems governance
Agent Interaction Design
For multi-product portfolios, we define how a brand identity translates consistently across different products, platforms, and contexts while allowing each product to retain its domain-specific character.
We create token-based Design Systems for multiple brands from one source. Shared components, patterns, and governance ensure predictable contribution, versioning, and releases as the system grows.
We design AI-powered product experiences: how agents communicate reasoning, how users override decisions, how escalation paths work, and how trust is built over time through feedback loops.
Rapid Coded Prototyping
MCP-Connected & AI-Dev Ready
Continuous Accessibility & Usability
Instead of static mockups, we build working coded prototypes. AI generates, tests, and refines them in days so ideas are validated with real users before committing to full development.
Our Design Systems connect through MCP so AI development tools can consume tokens, components, and specifications directly. This removes the handoff between design and development entirely.
AI-powered accessibility and usability checks run inside the design workflow in real time. Components are validated against WCAG standards continuously, with human review focused on the judgments that automation can't cover.

sections.heading: Our capabilities span the entire product lifecycle.
sections.text:
With AI handling the operational load, our PMs spend their time on the decisions that shape the product.
Product Management
Continuous Discovery
Competitive & Market Intelligence
Impact-Based Prioritization
Our PMs run always-on discovery using AI to process user behavior, support tickets, market signals, and competitive data in real time. Live insights replace periodic research reports.
AI monitors competitor releases, pricing changes, analyst signals, and market shifts. Product leadership receives synthesized briefings with clear signal, no noise.
AI-powered impact modeling ranks opportunities and backlog items against business outcomes: NRR, retention, expansion revenue, and cost-to-serve. Every product decision ties to a measurable result.
AI-Accelerated Specifications
Outcome-Aligned Roadmaps
Portfolio Strategy & Rationalization
AI drafts PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria from discovery inputs. Our PMs then refine strategic intent and edge cases, cutting specification time by 50%+.
We structure roadmaps around business outcomes and recalibrate prioritization continuously through AI-driven signal monitoring. What ships is what the business needs most.
Across multi-product portfolios, our teams map overlaps, gaps, and convergence opportunities between brands. Leadership gets clear recommendations on where to invest, where to consolidate, and where to sunset.
Continuous Validation
Stakeholder Alignment & Communication
AI-Handled Operational Load
Live user sessions, behavioral patterns, and adoption data are monitored alongside every release using AI analysis. Validation runs as a continuous process from day one, not as a phase after launch.
AI generates status updates, synthesizes cross-team dependencies, and drafts stakeholder communications. Our PMs spend their time aligning people around decisions, not writing reports about them.
AI handles the operational load: documentation, status reporting, data gathering, backlog grooming, and meeting preparation. PMs reclaim their time for strategy, stakeholder alignment, and the decisions that shape the product.

sections.heading: Mixed messages
sections.text:
AI can generate your interfaces.  They just don't look like your brand... Why?
Teams move fast with AI, but output drifts off-brand without a machine-readable foundation. AI can't fill gaps the way humans do: it needs structure, not guesswork.
Docs, code, and Figma are not aligned.  AI picks one version and repeats it everywhere.
Undocumented rules
The rules that matter most weren’t written down.  AI only works with what is documented.
Invisible structure
Humans navigate by intuition.  AI only sees what's explicitly structured.
Endless variations
AI can generate countless plausible directions. Without clear constraints, there’s nothing to keep those outputs brand-aligned.

Connect DS Accelerator to Jira, Figma, GitHub, Storybook and your AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Gemini).

You only do this once.
Select the component from Storybook and attach its Jira ticket. DS Accelerator pulls requirements from the ticket, asks clarifying questions and flags risks.

It then generates 3 design options with previews on desktop, tablet and mobile, each with pros and cons.

You pick one.
Once you pick an option, DS Accelerator writes the code on a separate branch.

It then runs accessibility, design system, responsiveness and code health checks, and flags anything that needs a manual review.

You review anything it flags.
DS Accelerator publishes the checked component to Storybook with a Proposed status, so the team can review it without it going into production.

Nothing is merged until an engineer approves the change.

sections.heading: Success Stories
sections.text: Proven solutions for similar challenges.

sections.heading: International SOS.
sections.text:
Reimagining global safety: how Nagarro and International SOS built the future of duty of care.
Unified access
We unified four fragmented products behind a single identity, replacing repeated logins across admin, manager, and subscriber experiences. Emergency assistance remains reachable before sign-in, reducing friction at critical moments and helping users access support faster when time and clarity matter most.
Design
We rebuilt subscriber and administrative journeys in parallel, establishing a consistent baseline for every employee regardless of subscription level. The experience spans web, iOS, and Android, with light and dark themes, eight languages, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
Scalable safety foundation
The Hummingbird Design System uses 200+ components and 800+ variables to power experiences from a single React Native codebase. This modular foundation helps the platform expand from supporting business travelers to protecting an organization’s entire workforce while maintaining consistency across products.

sections.heading: Datto.
sections.text:
A suite of products managed from a single place.
Scalable and adaptable components
We collaborated with Datto to ensure components functioned as intended. With many components and applications, we created easily resizable components for various contexts. Our goal was pixel-perfect, simple components letting Datto focus on product design instead of spacing, color, or type.
Unified design language and tokens
To ensure consistency across 40 applications and services, we established a shared visual language and token system. This foundation allowed the platform to scale while maintaining a cohesive look and feel. By defining reusable tokens for spacing, color, and type, we enabled the Design System to adapt to new features and products without visual fragmentation.
Governance, documentation, and collaboration
The Design System was designed to support long-term collaboration between design and engineering. We created documentation that made it easy for teams to understand how to use the system, audit existing work, and extend the system responsibly. This governance model helped Datto maintain consistency after major changes and mergers, ensuring the platform remained unified and easy to evolve.

sections.heading: RMS Design System.
sections.text:
Elegant implementation.
Discovery &  Strategy
We delved into the legacy implementation to gather insights
and potential opportunities through audits, workshops, competitor research analysis and stakeholder interviews.
Design
We started by mapping out all the existing experiences, used and unused components, icons and functionality so we saw it as a whole. Having this bird’s-eye view enabled us to develop an atomic-first library of reusable components which resulted in a stellar customer experience, simple usability and product development agility.
Engineering & QA
Our team wrote the components and patterns using the latest JavaScript frameworks, used SCSS variables for styles, jest for unit testing and Cypress for end to end testing. The beauty of it all was that a developer working on a particular app would also be familiar with the code of another, which translated into increased agility and development turnaround time.

sections.heading: Securra Health.
sections.text:
Building a scalable, modular platform for personalized healthcare solutions.
Multi-client scalability
A white-label architecture allows Securra to tailor branding and experiences for different healthcare clients without rebuilding core functionality. A three-tier token structure and Figma Variables keep each implementation distinct while maintaining consistency and supporting scalable growth.
Reusable design foundation
A modular library of shared components and patterns gives teams a dependable foundation for building new features. Reusable building blocks reduce duplicated effort, accelerate delivery, and help the platform evolve without losing usability or visual cohesion.
Engineering & QA
Clear component rules, documented patterns, and a modular system create a reliable handoff from design to development. Teams can extend the platform with greater confidence, maintain consistency across client implementations, and adapt the product as healthcare needs and market demands change.

sections.heading: SoSecure App.
sections.text:
Building mobile solutions to help
keep ADT's customers safe on the go.
Discovery &  Strategy
Our Product Strategy team evaluated the existing app through market and product analysis, identifying opportunities to improve its value and reach. Recommendations focused on accessibility, gamification, and user experience, creating a clear roadmap for growing SoSecure across consumer, B2B, and B2E markets.
Design
Product designers translated the strategy into an intuitive mobile experience and a multi-brand Design System in Figma. Reusable foundations standardized the creative process, supported consistent experiences, and gave SoSecure the flexibility to scale into SoSecure PRO while staying aligned with ADT’s brand and evolving market needs.
Engineering & QA
We embedded accessibility into implementation and validation, ensuring the app met ADA guidelines and reduced barriers for a broader audience. Close attention to product behavior and usability helped preserve a dependable safety experience as features evolved, supporting ADT’s goal of protecting customers wherever they are.
